title: Two chips and a software stack on $14.1M
subtitle: Not apples to apples. Extropic's bar is all disclosed equity since 2023; the others are single 2026 rounds. The memo's own reading is either undisclosed financing or exceptional capital efficiency.

rows.label: Euclyd
rows.detail: Company states over €200 million; $231M is a press conversion.

caption: A linear axis is deliberate. The point is that Extropic's bar is a sliver. Conventional AI chip startups raised rounds of $230M to $1B each in 2026, and Extropic has produced X0, Z1 and three open-source projects on a 2023 seed.
source: Converge Digest AI inference semiconductor tracker (Aug 2026); TechCrunch; company announcements. Extropic seed per PRNewswire, December 2023.
